cutoff.meaning: The meeting ends at 4:00 PM Eastern Time on 12 March 2026; any votes not cast by then are not counted.

negative_condition: The committee does not approve the compassionate-use request.
positive_condition: The committee approves the compassionate-use request.

proof.meaning: The official minutes of the 12 March meeting recording the votes of each member and the outcome.
proof.name: meeting minutes
proof.subject: committee members

proof.meaning: The chair's announcement of the result based on the votes cast.
proof.name: vote outcome

terminal_meaning: The committee's recorded votes under its own majority rule determine whether the compassionate-use request is approved or not at the 12 March meeting.
